Class LobbyState

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.controller.states.ControllerState
org.adsl.server.controller.states.LobbyState
All Implemented Interfaces:
RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>
public class LobbyState extends ControllerState
Manual state that manages the pre-game lobby.

Accepts EnterGameRequest until the lobby is full, rejects duplicates, and transitions to TotemPickingState when the host sends StartGameRequest with all seats filled. If the host disconnects all remaining players are evicted and a HostDisconnectedException is propagated to ServerController to clean up the game entry.

    • playerExit

      public void playerExit(VirtualClient virtualClient)
      Removes the player associated with virtualClient from the lobby, shared by ExitLobbyRequest and ClientDisconnected handling.

      If the lobby becomes empty the game is ended with no results. If the host leaves, every remaining player is evicted and a HostDisconnectedException is thrown so ServerController can discard this game. Otherwise the remaining players are notified.

      Parameters:
      virtualClient - the client leaving the lobby
      Throws:
      ServerException - if the client has no username or is not in this game
      HostDisconnectedException - if the host left the lobby
